aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable condition headers but misidentifies the changed factor and does not reliably support the extracted statistics.
issues: Changed factor is the filename instead of the condition comparison.
Baseline/test conditions are marked unclear despite headers showing NORMAL and two alternatives.
Outcome stats appear contaminated by header or standard values.
SPL and THD numeric evidence rows are not cited beyond headers.
Review title and purpose are unusable.
requiredUserQuestions: Should NEW VEDER GES TRADING and MATERIAL CD FROM KR be treated as two test conditions against NORMAL?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to material/supplier condition comparison.
Use NORMAL as baseline and the two labeled alternatives as changed conditions if confirmed.
Keep SPL, THD, and IMP as separate outcome domains under one review case.
Recompute stats excluding headers, standards, and sample labels.
Cite representative numeric rows for each sheet and condition, not only header rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Header citations prove condition labels, but numeric outcome citations are insufficient.
